Class DirectCircularList<E>

java.lang.Object
math.DirectCircularList<E>
public class DirectCircularList<E> extends Object

Title: Direct Circular List

Description: This class implements a direct access O(1) fixed size circular list extremely useful for caching purposes.

    • set

      public void set(int index, E value)
      Sets element in position index to specified value. This method is O(1) if values are inserted with adiacent indices, otherwise some computation is needed to mark null elements.
      Parameters:
      index - position of item to be set
      value - value for the item

    • get

      public E get(int index)
